profile.name: Brianna Okafor
profile.summary: QA specialist with 4 years of on-the-floor quality oversight for sterile injectables at a CDMO.

descriptions: Provide real-time QA oversight on 3 filling and packaging lines across night and weekend shifts
Perform line clearances, in-process checks and AQL inspections for about 25 lots a month
Review executed batch records and logbooks against SOPs and Good Documentation Practices; error rate down 40% in 2024
Act as designated observer for DEA Schedule II controlled substance handling and destruction
Verify label issuance and reconciliation for every packaging run
Qualified visual inspection and automated visual inspection on a new Seidenader line
Open deviations in MasterControl and lead OOS/OOT and CAPA investigations using 5 Whys and Fishbone
Coach 30+ operators on cGMP and cleanroom gowning; gowning failures fell from 9 to 2 per quarter
Prepared the floor for 2 FDA inspections and 6 internal audits with no observations on my lines
Ran environmental monitoring and cleaning verification sampling in ISO 7 and ISO 8 rooms
